provider_model_version: catalog alias; immutable service snapshot unknown
primary_contrast: 100 * (test_gap_fb_protected - test_gap_fb_unprotected), percentage points; negative favors protection

statistics.unit: paired data block and search seed

failure_policy: Each request is dispatched at most once. Parse failures consume the proposal slot. Indeterminate/provider failures stop that job and preserve missingness; no automatic retry or replacement. Test is opened only after all jobs are terminal or an explicit infrastructure halt is recorded.
test_policy: Select the validation-best valid program using (loss, node id), then evaluate it once on the held-out test split in a separate stage. Test failure receives gap 1.0 and a validity flag.
claims: Prospective single-model TSP14 factor experiment. It can test whether executable protection changes branch continuation and quality under this task and budget. It cannot establish cross-model, cross-task, or universal superiority.
progression_gate: Run the five-policy extension only if at least 8 of 12 paired jobs complete, protection changes realized development in at least 3 block-seed pairs, and the paired quality result is not infrastructure-dominated. A null or negative result is retained as a valid scientific outcome.
